title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An Open-Source Package for EU-AI-Act-Compliant Development / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein Open-Source-Paket f\"ur die KI-VO-konforme Entwicklung
abstract: arXiv:2604.23859v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI

translated_title: 安全关键环境中的时间序列预测：一个符合欧盟人工智能法案的开源开发包
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2604.23859v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：通过spotforecast2-safe，我们提出了一种集成式合规设计方法，用于在安全关键环境中基于Python的时间序列点预测。对相关开源工具的审查显示，现有合规解决方案通常在被使用的库外部运行——例如作为扫描器、模板或运行时层。spotforecast2-safe采取了相反的方法，将欧盟法规2024/1689（欧盟人工智能法案，德语：KI-VO）、IEC 61508、ISA/IEC 62443标准系列以及网络弹性法案的要求锚定在库内部：在应用程序编程接口契约、持久化格式和持续集成门控中。该方法通过四条不可协商的代码开发规则（零死代码、确定性处理、故障安全处理、最小依赖）以及相应的过程规则（模型卡、可执行文档字符串、持续集成）得以实施。
tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为spotforecast2-safe的开源Python包，通过将欧盟AI法案等安全法规要求直接嵌入库的API、存储格式和CI流程中，实现了安全关键环境下时间序列预测的合规设计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents spotforecast2-safe, an open-source Python package that embeds EU AI Act and other safety regulations directly into the library's API, persistence formats, and CI gates for compliant time-series forecasting in safety-critical environments.
